latHint: Think holding something up on purpose - not a train delay.
pivHint: A station DELAY holds up a train - but to DELAY something on purpose means to do what?
winText: Buying time. DELAY was the pivot - a held-up train to STALLing for time.
lossText: STALL - to DELAY on purpose. DELAY was the pivot: a train's DELAY to STALLing deliberately.
